injections.rationale: The link capacity constraint gates flow on the binary selection variable via the product C_ij * x_ij, so an unselected link (x_ij=0) forces zero flow. Replacing the product with a sum C_ij + x_ij is structurally similar but destroys the gating: an unselected link would still admit flow up to its full capacity, contradicting the relay-selection model the text describes. Perturbs the existing constraint in place rather than appending anything.
injections.ground_truth_description: Capacity constraint changed from f_ij <= C_ij * x_ij to f_ij <= C_ij + x_ij, removing the binary gating of link flow.

truth.term_role: capacity gating term (product of capacity and binary selector)
